sub_agent_reviews.summary: Single merged Scout covered llm-agent, llm-post-training, and ai-safety; AgentHPOBench ranked first and passed exact remote-corpus grep.
Main agent read the arXiv PDF, TeX source, official README, setup notes, task manifest, and validation code before drafting.
Article maps task construction, sequential HPO formulation, metrics, harness audit, repository layout, and result validation boundaries.
Article compares AgentHPOBench with broad ML-agent benchmarks and conventional HPO benchmarks without inventing unsupported experiments.
Limitations cover 30-task scale, API single-run evidence, full-budget interpretation, reproducibility cost, and final-step scoring boundary.
Markdown uses TL;DR, tables, formulas, pseudocode, Mermaid, and localized images with measured CJK count above 5000.
